author: shinfkenafk

title: Annoying!
body: Everytime I open the app from the widget, an offer appears first. I set a weekly goal which I have to do 3 times/week and it is impossible to track this way, for some reason when I look at the date two days ago it says 3/3 and today it is 0/3? I started using the app 5 days ago and it is a Saturday, my week starts on a Monday, so what’s the deal with that? I would love to continue using the app but it seriously makes me mad.
author: Nicolacek

title: Great app, huge potential
body:
The app is great, better than next best competitor as it is extremely polished and stable. Although it does not fully fit my design taste (everything is a bit too large, huge paddings everywhere, large fonts), I learned to like it.

Two negatives I see so far:
- Monthly habits can be set to part of the month only.
- Widgets are very space-inefficient (they could fit much more data) - would be great to have more condensed widgets and a widget with a calendar view.
